station.name: Mean of Seoul's 25 district monitors
station.aggregation: Unweighted mean of valid hourly concentrations at the 25 district monitors; at least 20 monitors required per hour. Each included monitor has at least 75% valid hours in the year and in every season. This is not a population-weighted exposure estimate.

periodBasis: UTC calendar year; local times are available using the stated time zone

timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: The portal describes hourly means but does not explicitly identify hour-start versus hour-end in the inspected metadata. Source labels are preserved without a one-hour shift.
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Subtract 9 hours from the source local label. No daylight-saving time in Seoul in 2024.
timeConvention.interpretation_limit: Use calendar/seasonal and rolling comparisons. Exact simultaneous-hour comparisons may have a one-hour convention offset until confirmed with the provider.

quality.missingTreatment: null; no interpolation or imputation; network mean requires at least 20 of 25 monitors
quality.outOfPeriodNote: Nine network hours labelled 1 January 2024 00:00–08:00 KST fall in UTC 2023; the nine UTC hours after 31 December 2024 14:00 are unavailable in this source file and remain null.
quality.qaStatus: Archived municipal observations; final national ratification status is not supplied in this file.
